description: This file defines a Flutter widget called PostFrameRunner that executes a callback once after the first frame is rendered, then displays a child widget. It is used for performing side-effects like preloading assets or logging after initial UI build.

classes.name: PostFrameRunner
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that runs a provided asynchronous callback after the first frame and then displays its child.

classes.description: State class for PostFrameRunner that manages executing the callback once during dependency changes.
